text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا

translations.asad: CONSIDER these [messages,] sent forth in waves
translations.sahih: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

translations.asad: and then storming on with a tempest's force!
translations.sahih: And the winds that blow violently

translations.asad: Consider these [messages] that spread [the truth] far and wide,
translations.sahih: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

translations.asad: thus separating [right and wrong] with all clarity,
translations.sahih: And those [angels] who bring criterion

translations.asad: and then giving forth a reminder,
translations.sahih: And those [angels] who deliver a message

translations.asad: [promising] freedom from blame or [offering] a warning!
translations.sahih: As justification or warning,

translations.asad: BEHOLD, all that you are told to expect will surely come to pass.
translations.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

translations.asad: Thus, [it will come to pass] when the stars are effaced,
translations.sahih: So when the stars are obliterated

translations.asad: and when the sky is rent asunder,
translations.sahih: And when the heaven is opened

translations.asad: and when the mountains are scattered like dust,
translations.sahih: And when the mountains are blown away

translations.asad: and when all the apostles are called together at a time appointed...
translations.sahih: And when the messengers' time has come...

translations.asad: For what day has the term [of all this] been set?
translations.sahih: For what Day was it postponed?

translations.asad: For the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false]!
translations.sahih: For the Day of Judgement.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that Day of Distinction will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: Did We not destroy [so many of] those [sinners] of olden days?
translations.sahih: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

translations.asad: And We shall let them be followed by those of later times:
translations.sahih: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

translations.asad: [for] thus do We deal with such as are lost in sin.
translations.sahih: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: Did We not create you out of a humble fluid
translations.sahih: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

translations.asad: which We then let remain in [the womb's] firm keeping
translations.sahih: And We placed it in a firm lodging

translations.asad: for a term pre-ordained?
translations.sahih: For a known extent.

translations.asad: Thus have We determined [the nature of man's creation]: and excellent indeed is Our power to determine [what is to be]!
translations.sahih: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

translations.asad: Woe, on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: Have We not caused the earth to hold within itself
translations.sahih: Have We not made the earth a container

translations.asad: the living and the dead?
translations.sahih: Of the living and the dead?

text.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا

translations.asad: and have We not set on it proud, firm mountains, and given you sweet water to drink?
translations.sahih: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.asad: GO ON towards that [resurrection] which you were wont to call a lie!
translations.sahih: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

text.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ

translations.asad: Go on towards the threefold shadow
translations.sahih: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

text.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

translations.asad: that will offer no [cooling] shade and will be of no avail against the flame
translations.sahih: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

translations.asad: which – behold!- will throw up sparks like [burning] logs,
translations.sahih: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

translations.asad: like giant fiery ropes!
translations.sahih: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: that Day on which they will not [be able to] utter a word,
translations.sahih: This is a Day they will not speak,

translations.asad: nor be allowed to proffer excuses!
translations.sahih: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: that Day of Distinction [between the true and the false, when they will be told]: "We have brought you together with those [sinners] of olden times;
translations.sahih: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

translations.asad: and if you [think that you] have a subterfuge left, try to outwit Me!"
translations.sahih: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: [AS AGAINST this,] behold, the God-conscious shall dwell amidst [cooling] shades and springs,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

translations.asad: and [partake of] whatever fruit they may desire;
translations.sahih: And fruits from whatever they desire,

text.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: [and they will be told:] "Eat and drink in good cheer in return for what you did [in life]!"
translations.sahih: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

translations.asad: Thus, behold, do We reward the doers of good;
translations.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

translations.asad: [but] woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: EAT [your fill] and enjoy your life for a little while, O you who are lost in sin!
translations.sahih: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

translations.asad: [But] woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth,
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

translations.asad: and when they are told, "Bow down [before God]", do not bow down:
translations.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

translations.asad: woe on that Day unto those who give the to the truth!
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

translations.asad: In what other tiding, then, will they, after this, believe?
translations.sahih: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
